description: This file defines an Express router for handling billing history related API endpoints such as adding, listing, retrieving last product, removing, updating, and clearing billing history.

methods.name: addBillingHistory
methods.description: Handler for adding a new billing history record.

methods.name: listBillingHistory
methods.description: Handler for retrieving a list of billing history records.

methods.name: clearBillingHistory
methods.description: Handler for clearing all billing history records.

methods.name: retrieveLastProduct
methods.description: Handler for retrieving the last product from billing history.

methods.name: removeHistory
methods.description: Handler for removing specific billing history records.

methods.name: editBillHistory
methods.description: Handler for editing an existing billing history record.
